physics_notes:
# coffee_capsule_carton — realism QA

Status: **provisional_B_not_certified**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette B, proportions B, colour_texture B, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.774.

Evidence: f3043, f3039, f3021. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/coffee_capsule_carton_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Retraced clipped/overlapping source contours, corrected inclined carton depth and full side silhouette, and refit all ten placements including three upper cartons. Re-baked static per-instance printed faces and side surfaces.
- Rebuilt physical mass estimates from constituent density and thin-shell/contact geometry; updated part COM, affine instance mass and material-specific friction.
- Rebuilt reproducible Blender/GLB meshes and collision geometry; preserved instance and review metadata in standalone rebuilds.
- Added closed-flap retention so gravity does not pull tucked/glued carton flaps through the box; fold hinges are retained for explicit opening after release.

Remaining:
- Mass, contents, friction, restitution and hidden wall thickness are unmeasured priors.
- Static visible-state evidence does not verify actuation force, thread pitch, seal behavior or fracture. Closed-retention constraints require explicit release actions in a runtime importer.
